a2-unit-29.29.1 At the airport:
Narrator: Situation one. Check-in.
Agent: Good morning. Where are you flying to today?
Ana: To São Paulo.
Agent: May I see your passport, please?
Ana: Here you are.
Agent: Thank you. Are you checking any bags today?
Ana: Just this one.
Agent: Did you pack your bag yourself?
Ana: Yes, I did.
Agent: Place your bag on the scale, please.
Ana: OK.
Agent: Here's your boarding pass. Go through security and make your way to gate M12. The flight will be ready to board at 4:35.
Ana: Sorry, which gate?
Agent: Gate M12.
Ana: Thank you.
Narrator: Situation two. Security.
Officer: Place your items in the bin.
Officer: Take off your belt and your jacket, please.
Officer: Step this way, please.
Officer: Are you wearing any jewelry?
Ana: No, I'm not.
Officer: Can you open your bag, please?
Ana: Of course.
Narrator: Situation three. On the plane.
Ana: Excuse me. Are you sure this is your seat? I think I have the aisle seat.
Passenger: Oh, sorry. You're right. I'm in the wrong seat.
Attendant: Please place your bags in the overhead bins.
Ana: Oh, no. There's no room!
Passenger: Try over there. There's some space.
Attendant: Please fasten your seat belt when we switch on the sign. We are about to take off.
Attendant: We are experiencing some turbulence, but we'll shortly be passing through the cabin with drinks and snacks.
Passenger: Great. I really need a coffee.
Ana: So do I!
Attendant: If you need anything, please ask a flight attendant.
Ana: Oh, no! I'm so sorry. Are you OK? Excuse me! Do you have any napkins? I spilled my coffee!
